Global Bonds Move Towards Higher Interest Rates

Global bond markets are showing a trend towards higher neutral interest rates. This shift suggests a potential move away from the era of ultra-low borrowing costs experienced in recent years. The implications of this change are being analyzed, with discussions focusing on who might bear the costs of this transition to a higher-rate environment. The movement indicates a significant adjustment in global financial conditions.
